category_title: High-achieving, competitive students who prioritize individual progress over group collaboration
minimal_context: Patty and her peer Marie are working on the Fraction Maze task to compare 4 1/3 and 4 1/2 using fraction circle pieces.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this part of the Fraction Maze, you and Marie need to compare 4 1/3 and 4 1/2.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: 4 1/2 is greater. When I’ve worked a problem out over and over, time and time again, and I absolutely know it, I'm not going to change my answer.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Marie wrote down that 4 1/3 is greater. What should we do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That's annoying. I'm not going to blindly believe her thinking. My opinion just kicks in. Instinct, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to talk it over with her and see what happens.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slaps the table and emphatically reaches for the fraction circle pieces) I guess it’s just my nature, I’m really competitive! I'm going to use these to debunk her claim right now.
